heading_en: Buckets, Risk Weights and Correlations for Curvature Risk
summary_ja: 各リスク・クラスのカーベチャー・リスクについて、バケット分類、リスク・ウェイト及び相関係数(デルタ・リスクの値の二乗等)を定める。
summary_en: Sets the bucket classification, risk weights and correlation coefficients for curvature risk of each risk class, largely by applying the delta risk provisions mutatis mutandis and squaring the resulting correlations.
paragraphs: For curvature risk of each risk class, risk factors shall be classified into buckets as provided in each of the following items according to the following categories of risk class. (i) General interest rate risk: Article 263-2, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (ii) Credit spread risk on non-securitization products: Article 263-3, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (iii) Credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP): Article 263-4, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (iv) Credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP): Article 263-5, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (v) Equity risk: Article 264, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (vi) Commodity risk: Article 264-2, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (vii) Foreign exchange risk: Article 264-3, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk".

The risk weights used for curvature risk of each risk class shall be as provided in each of the following items according to the following categories of risk class. (i) General interest rate risk: as prescribed in (a) through (c) below according to the following categories of curve. (a) Risk-free yield curve: the largest of the risk weights prescribed in the lower column of the table in Article 263-2, paragraph (2). (b) Inflation flat curve and cross-currency basis flat curve: Article 263-2, paragraph (3) applies mutatis mutandis. (c) Curves of specified currencies: the value obtained by dividing the largest of the risk weights prescribed in the lower column of the table in Article 263-2, paragraph (2) by the square root of 2. (ii) Credit spread risk on non-securitization products: Article 263-3, paragraph (2) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (iii) Credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP): Article 263-4, paragraph (2) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (iv) Credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP): Article 263-5, paragraph (2) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (v) Equity risk: Article 264, paragraph (2) (limited to the part relating to the risk weights for the spot price of equities) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (vi) Commodity risk: Article 264-2, paragraph (2) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (vii) Foreign exchange risk: Article 264-3, paragraphs (2) and (3) apply mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in paragraph (2) of that Article shall be read as "curvature risk".

The correlation coefficient (ρ_{kl}) between risk factors used for curvature risk of each risk class shall be the value obtained by squaring the value determined in each of the following items according to the following categories of risk class. (i) General interest rate risk: the value of the correlation coefficient ρ_{kl} calculated by applying Article 263-2, paragraph (5) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (ii) Credit spread risk on non-securitization products: the value prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following categories of bucket number classified under paragraph (1), item (ii). (a) Bucket numbers 1 through 15: the value of {{F:p387i0}} calculated by applying Article 263-3, paragraph (4), item (i) mutatis mutandis. (b) Bucket number 17 or 18: the value of {{F:p387i1}} calculated by applying Article 263-3, paragraph (5), item (i) mutatis mutandis. (iii) Credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP): the value of {{F:p387i2}} calculated by applying Article 263-4, paragraph (4), item (i) mutatis mutandis. (iv) Credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP): the value of {{F:p387i3}} calculated by applying Article 263-5, paragraph (4), item (i) mutatis mutandis. (v) Equity risk: the value of ρ_{kl} calculated by applying Article 264, paragraph (3) or (4) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that Article shall be read as "curvature risk". (vi) Commodity risk: the value of {{F:p387i4}} calculated by applying Article 264-2, paragraph (4), item (i) mutatis mutandis.

Notwithstanding Article 260-3, paragraph (5) and the preceding paragraph, for curvature risk of each risk class, the aggregation of risk-weighted sensitivities within the same bucket shall, where the bucket classified under paragraph (1) falls under bucket number 16 in the table in Article 263-3, paragraph (1), item (i), bucket number 16 in the table in Article 263-4, paragraph (1), item (i), bucket number 25 in the table in Article 263-5, paragraph (1), item (i) or bucket number 11 in the table in Article 264, paragraph (1), item (i), be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p387i5}}

The correlation coefficient (γ_{bc}) between buckets used for curvature risk of each risk class shall be the value obtained by squaring the value of the correlation coefficient (γ_{bc}) determined in each of the following items according to the following categories of risk class. (i) General interest rate risk: the value calculated by applying Article 263-2, paragraph (7) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (ii) Credit spread risk on non-securitization products: the value calculated by applying Article 263-3, paragraphs (7) and (8) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in paragraph (7) of that Article shall be read as "curvature risk". (iii) Credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP): the value calculated by applying Article 263-4, paragraphs (5) and (6) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in paragraph (5) of that Article shall be read as "curvature risk". (iv) Credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP): the value calculated by applying Article 263-5, paragraphs (6) and (7) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in paragraph (6) of that Article shall be read as "curvature risk", and the phrase "between buckets (excluding bucket number 25)" shall be read as "between buckets". (v) Equity risk: the value calculated by applying Article 264, paragraph (5) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (vi) Commodity risk: the value calculated by applying Article 264-2, paragraph (6) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk". (vii) Foreign exchange risk: the value calculated by applying Article 264-3, paragraph (4) mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "curvature risk".
